environment.description: ECS Fargate task running the notification-consumer service in a private subnet with NAT gateway. The container runs as root with default Docker capabilities. The task role has SQS read/delete permissions. No network egress restrictions beyond the VPC NAT. The container filesystem is writable. Instance metadata service v1 is accessible at 169.254.169.254.

config.network: private subnet with NAT, no egress filtering
